scope: Dated, sourced platform constraints and exact-final-text detector applicability

red_evidence.reason: the platform constraint and detector applicability modules did not exist

assertions: platform requirements apply only to the exact channel, format, account, region, and action scope
expired or unknown mandatory requirements block the affected remote action while preserving working export
unsupported ranking-algorithm multipliers are rejected rather than represented as sourced constraints
unsupported detector language or input scope is not_evaluable and never a pass
detection report reuse requires the exact final-text hash and policy identity
no universal AI-content score or threshold is invented
